notes.title: Version 1.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
- Updated engine version.
- Fixed an issue where "Cruel and Unusual" difficulty would not unlock.
- Fixed an issue where the "When Mowers Collide" achievement had incorrect requirements.
- Fixed an issue where campaign completion achievements would not unlock. If you were affected by this issue, you will need to complete any level with any number of stars to unlock the achievements.
- Some particle effects have had minor adjustments to work correctly with the updated engine.
- Lighting shader falloff is now clamped to a valid range. This fixes lighting artifacts with the most notable being episode 2, level 13.
